svg.title: One 8x8 block of quantized DCT coefficients, showing which cells are safe to embed data in
svg.desc: A grid of 64 cells representing one quantized 8x8 DCT block. The top-left DC coefficient is marked as always skipped. Most cells are zero after quantization and are also skipped. Cells with value plus or minus 1 are skipped due to shrinkage risk. Only cells with absolute value 2 or greater, excluding the DC cell, are usable for embedding.
